name: a-place-is-a-path
query: :number/plus (::fn | takes :by |~~ The by. ~~| /0 | impl ~(add by)) | 5 | plus 2

name: a-place-reads-softly-by-query
query: :number/plus (::fn | takes :by |~~ The by. ~~| ~(query /0 1) | impl ~(add by)) | 5 | plus

name: an-input-carries-the-page-of-its-command
query: :any/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ How many. ~~| /0 | impl ~(x)) | ::any/m/x | doc | content

name: a-name-a-reader-verb-declares-no-input-under-is-refused-with-no-addresses
query: :number/twice (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 ::number | impl ~(mul x)) | ::twice | doc :nosuch !| get [~(type) /addresses]

name: a-path-of-anchors-reads-an-input-of-a-word-under-a-label
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/twice (::fn | takes :x |~~ The factor. ~~| /0 ::number | impl ~(mul x)) | ::Box | doc [:twice :x]

name: an-invariant-of-the-answer-refuses-an-answer-that-breaks-it
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/half |~~ Half. ~~| (::fn | holds :answer/NotWholeError |~~ NotWholeError. ~~| ~(eq (round)) | returns |~~ The half. ~~| ::number | impl ~(get /0 | div 2)) | ::Box[5] | half !| get [~(type) /actualValue]

name: a-place-counted-from-the-end-reads-the-last-object
query: :any/lastOf (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /-1 | impl ~(x)) | get [~(5 | lastOf 1 2) ~(5 | lastOf !| type)]

name: a-soft-place-counted-from-the-end-is-read-as-query-reads-it
query: :any/lastOf (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| ~(query /-1) | impl ~(x)) | get [~(5 | lastOf 1 2) ~(5 | lastOf)]

name: a-path-from-a-place-counts-that-place
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/put (::fn | takes :k |~~ The k. ~~| /0/k | impl ~(k)) | ::Box[1] | get [~(put {:k 2}) ~(put {:k 2} 3 !| type)]

name: an-invariant-of-each-value-of-a-map-runs-as-code-and-hands-the-map-on
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/sumIt (::fn | takes :m |~~ M ~~| /0 ::map | holds :m/ElementNotNumberError |~~ Each value is a number. ~~| ~(every ~(is ::number)) | impl ~(m | vals | sum)) | ::Box[1] | sumIt {:a 1 :b 2}

name: an-input-that-reads-from-the-end-reads-the-last-object
query: :any/runAll (::fn | takes :steps |~~ The steps. ~~| /-1 [::quote] | impl ~(steps | count)) | 5 | get [~(runAll (get /nope) [~(1)] !| type) ~(runAll 7 [~(1)])]

name: an-input-of-each-element-keeps-a-set-a-set
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/kindOf (::fn | takes :m |~~ M ~~| /0 [::number] | impl ~(m | type)) | ::Box[1] | get [~(kindOf #[1 2]) ~(kindOf [1 2])]

name: an-element-of-a-value-is-counted-from-zero
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/m (::fn | takes :xs |~~ X ~~| /0 [::number] | impl ~(xs)) | ::Box[1] | m [1 "a"] !| get [~(type) /index]

name: an-input-of-each-element-hands-a-set-as-the-set-of-their-values
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/kindOf (::fn | takes :m |~~ M ~~| /0 [::number] | impl ~(get [~(m | type) ~(m | map ~type)])) | ::Box[1] | get [~(kindOf #[::N#1 2]) ~(kindOf ::T#[1 2]) ~(kindOf [::N#1 2])]

name: an-input-of-each-element-hands-a-quote-and-a-doc-as-they-are
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/kindOf (::fn | takes :m |~~ M ~~| /0 [::string] | impl ~(m | type)) | ::Box[1] | get [~(kindOf ~("a")) ~(kindOf (|~~ a ~~|))]

name: an-input-of-each-element-hands-a-quote-or-a-doc-under-a-tag-as-it-is
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/kindOf (::fn | takes :m |~~ M ~~| /0 [::string] | impl ~(m | type)) | ::Box[1] | get [~(kindOf ::T~("a")) ~(kindOf ::T|~~ a ~~|)]

name: a-place-reads-an-index-as-get-reads-it
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| | :Box/q (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /1e0 | impl ~(x)) | ::Box[1] | get [~(q 5 6 !| type) ~([5 6] | get /1e0 !| type)]

name: the-page-of-an-input-is-reached-by-its-name
query: :number/f (::fn | takes :n |~~ how many ~~| /0 | impl ~(add n)) | ::number/f | doc :n | content

name: the-source-of-an-address-holds-every-declaration-under-it
query: :Box |~~ A parcel. ~~| | :Box/put |~~ Puts a weight in. ~~| (::fn | takes :w |~~ The weight. ~~| /0 | impl ~(append w)) | ::Box | source | map /name

name: the-page-of-a-kind-holds-no-page-of-its-words
query: ::vec | doc | content | contains "The first count elements"

name: a-quote-assembled-from-data-is-printed
query: ~(add 1 | mul 2) | take 1 | :q it | get [~(q)] | tag ::doc | content

name: a-reducer-with-a-second-input-left-out-is-refused-by-the-input
query: :number/bad2 (::fn | takes :a |~~ The a. ~~| /0 | takes :b |~~ The b. ~~| /1 | impl ~(a)) | [1 2 3] | reduce 0 ~bad2 !| type

name: a-doc-with-a-link-prints-back-as-itself
query: |~~ a ::link~(add 1) b ~~| | :d it | print | parse | first | eq d

name: a-snippet-opens-to-what-it-shows
query: |~~ a ::snippet~(1 | add 1) b ~~| | snippets | first | open

name: a-doc-keeps-its-prose-and-its-quotes-as-segments
query: |~~ a ~(1) b ::link~(::vec | doc) c ~~| | segments | map ~type
